title: Water through piezoelectric spirals generating electricity

tellings.quote: Maybe the water goes through the these spirals, and the spirals are uh made by piezoelectric material.

plain: Filippo Biondi, a scientist who used radar to scan beneath the pyramid of Khafre at Giza in Egypt, suggests that water may once have flowed through spiral structures under it made of piezoelectric material, the kind that gives off electricity when squeezed. He floats it as a possibility, linking it to the pyramid researcher Christopher Dunn. If true, the pyramid would have worked as a kind of power plant.
